parameters.query:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT $1::text AS booking_key, $2::text AS client_name, $3::text AS client_phone,
         $4::text AS channel, $5::text AS channel_user_id, $6::text AS service_id,
         $7::text AS stylist_id, $8::timestamptz AS starts_at, $9::text AS notes
),
svc AS (SELECT s.* FROM service s JOIN p ON s.id = p.service_id WHERE s.active),
win AS (SELECT p.starts_at AS s, p.starts_at + make_interval(mins => svc.duration_min) AS e FROM p, svc),
existing AS (SELECT a.* FROM appointment a JOIN p ON a.booking_key = p.booking_key),
checks AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM existing) > 0 AS is_replay,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM svc) > 0     AS service_ok,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stylist st, p WHERE st.id = p.stylist_id AND st.active) AS stylist_ok,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stylist_service ss, p
            WHERE ss.stylist_id = p.stylist_id AND ss.service_id = p.service_id) AS performs,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM business_hours bh, p, win
            WHERE bh.stylist_id = p.stylist_id
              AND bh.weekday = EXTRACT(DOW FROM (win.s AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila')::date)::smallint
              AND win.s >= (((win.s AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila')::date + bh.opens_at)  AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila')
              AND win.e <= (((win.s AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila')::date + bh.closes_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila')) AS hours_ok,
    COALESCE((SELECT s FROM win) > now(), false) AS not_past,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM appointment a, p, win
            WHERE a.stylist_id = p.stylist_id AND a.status = 'confirmed'
              AND tstzrange(a.starts_at, a.ends_at) && tstzrange(win.s, win.e)) AS taken
),
cli AS (
  INSERT INTO client (id, name, phone, channel, channel_user_id)
  SELECT 'cli_' || substr(md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text), 1, 12),
         p.client_name, p.client_phone, p.channel, p.channel_user_id
  FROM p, checks c
  WHERE c.service_ok AND c.stylist_ok AND c.performs AND c.hours_ok
    AND c.not_past AND NOT c.taken AND NOT c.is_replay
  ON CONFLICT (channel, channel_user_id) WHERE channel IS NOT NULL AND channel_user_id IS NOT NULL
  DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name,
                phone = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.phone, client.phone),
                updated_at = now()
  RETURNING id
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO appointment (ref, booking_key, client_id, stylist_id, service_id, starts_at, ends_at, source, notes)
  SELECT 'BK-' || lpad(nextval('appointment_ref_seq')::text, 5, '0'),
         p.booking_key, cli.id, p.stylist_id, p.service_id, win.s, win.e, 'chat', p.notes
  FROM p, win, cli
  -- DO UPDATE, not DO NOTHING: when two calls carrying the SAME booking_key race, the loser's
  -- DO NOTHING returns no row AND cannot see the winner's freshly committed row (one statement,
  -- one snapshot) — so it would report failure for a booking that actually succeeded. DO UPDATE
  -- waits for the winner, then returns that row. `xmax = 0` is how you tell a real insert from a
  -- returned conflict.
  ON CONFLICT (booking_key) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = now()
  RETURNING appointment.ref, appointment.status, appointment.client_id, appointment.stylist_id,
            appointment.service_id, appointment.starts_at, appointment.ends_at,
            (xmax = 0) AS was_inserted
),
final AS (
  SELECT ref, status, client_id, stylist_id, service_id, starts_at, ends_at FROM ins
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ref, status, client_id, stylist_id, service_id, starts_at, ends_at FROM existing
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'is_replay',  (SELECT is_replay  FROM checks),
  'service_ok', (SELECT service_ok FROM checks),
  'stylist_ok', (SELECT stylist_ok FROM checks),
  'performs',   (SELECT performs   FROM checks),
  'hours_ok',   (SELECT hours_ok   FROM checks),
  'not_past',   (SELECT not_past   FROM checks),
  'taken',      (SELECT taken      FROM checks),
  'created',      COALESCE((SELECT bool_or(was_inserted)     FROM ins), false),
  'raced_replay', COALESCE((SELECT bool_or(NOT was_inserted) FROM ins), false),
  'params_match', COALESCE((SELECT e.service_id = p.service_id AND e.stylist_id = p.stylist_id
                              AND e.starts_at = win.s
                            FROM existing e, p, win), true),
  'booking', (SELECT json_build_object(
                'ref', f.ref, 'status', f.status,
                'client_id', f.client_id,
                'client_name', COALESCE(c.name, (SELECT client_name FROM p)),
                'stylist_id', f.stylist_id, 'stylist_name', st.name,
                'service_id', f.service_id, 'service_name', sv.name,
                'duration_min', sv.duration_min, 'price_php', sv.price_php,
                'starts_at_utc',   to_char(f.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
                'ends_at_utc',     to_char(f.ends_at   AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
                'starts_at_local', to_char(f.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'),
                'ends_at_local',   to_char(f.ends_at   AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila','HH24:MI'))
              FROM final f
              -- LEFT, not INNER: a client inserted by the `cli` CTE above is NOT visible to
              -- this SELECT (every part of one statement reads the same pre-statement
              -- snapshot), so an INNER JOIN silently drops the booking of any FIRST-TIME
              -- client — the one case a demo with pre-seeded clients never exercises.
              LEFT JOIN client  c  ON c.id  = f.client_id
              JOIN stylist st ON st.id = f.stylist_id
              JOIN service sv ON sv.id = f.service_id
              LIMIT 1)
) AS result;

## 21 · create booking

**In** `{booking_key, client:{name, phone?, channel?, channel_user_id?}, service_id, stylist_id, starts_at, notes?}`
**Out** `{ok:true, data:{ref, idempotent_replay, …}}`

`ends_at` is ALWAYS derived from `service.duration_min` — a caller cannot shorten it to sneak past the double-booking guard. Same `booking_key` + same params replays the original booking; same key + different params is `booking_key_conflict`, never a silent wrong confirmation.

`reason`: `invalid_input` · `invalid_timestamp` · `service_not_found` · `stylist_not_found` · `stylist_does_not_perform_service` · `starts_in_the_past` · `outside_business_hours` · `slot_taken` · `booking_key_conflict` · `db_unavailable` · `timeout`
